title: "Zach M"
format: html
---

```{r}
#load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(baseballr)
```

```{r}
Park_data_24 <- fg_park(2024) |>
  arrange(desc(basic_5yr))
```

```{r}
# view basics of data
summary(Park_data_24) #get summary of values of each variable

head(Park_data_24) #view what the data looks like

```
```{r}
#view basic stats of 5year park factor stats
ggplot(Park_data_24, aes(x = basic_5yr)) +
  geom_histogram()
```


```{r}
# looking at park factor compared to home runs
ggplot(Park_data_24, aes(x = hr, y = basic_5yr)) +
   geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = home_team), angle = 360, vjust = 0, nudge_y = - 0.5)
```

```{r}
#get batting data
batting_data <- fg_batter_leaders(startseason = 2024, endseason = 2024)
```

```{r}
# viwe home run data
summary(batting_data)
head(batting_data)
```

```{r}
ggplot(batting_data, aes(x = HR)) +
  geom_density()
```

```{r}
batting_data|>
  filter(team_name %in% c("COR", "BOS", "COL", "CIN", "KCR")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = HR, y = R, color = team_name)) +
        geom_point()
```
